name: 180-degree heavy-duty flipper
summary: Designed for flipping large or heavy products, achieving precise 180-degree flipping. Solves difficulties and safety issues of manual flipping due to process requirements.
contentHtml:
The 180-degree heavy-duty flipper is a core device developed by TXAM for flipping large and heavy products.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a precision mechanical structure combined with a servo drive system to achieve one-button 180-degree flipping. The flipping process is smooth with precise positioning, effectively solving the difficulties and safety hazards of manual flipping.

Technical Advantages

  • Flipping cycle time of 15-55 seconds, high efficiency
  • One-button operation, simple and convenient
  • High load capacity, suitable for large products like TVs and educational monitors
  • Multiple models available: TXM-B-105 series (A/B/C) and 205A
